onset.Description: Detected onset (s from the first sample of the recording): the first sample after the first stimulation-artefact step of the pulse, train or block.

duration.Description: 0 for single pulses; for trains and blocks the time from the first to the last detected pulse (trains: plus one pulse interval).

Levels.stim_block_100Hz: block of continuous 100 Hz stimulation, detected from the artefact

sample.Description: onset x sampling frequency (0-based sample index in the data file).

peak_score.Description: Largest detection score of the event: for pulses and trains the step score (90th percentile across contacts of |sample step| / robust SD of that contact's steps); for 100 Hz blocks the largest comb score (log10 power ratio, see README).

n_pulses.Description: Number of detected pulses in the event (n/a for 100 Hz blocks, where single pulses are not counted).

method.Description: How onset and duration were obtained.

Levels.spectral: 100 Hz block from the spectral comb score only (onset/offset precision about +-0.5 s)

Description: Stimulation onsets DETECTED FROM THE STIMULATION ARTEFACT in the recorded signals. Not from a source: the release does not annotate these events. Method, thresholds and counts: README of this derivative; code: code/fix-20261030_stimartefact/.
